description: Daily trading signals, market analysis, and a tight-knit community of serious traders.
refund_policy: No refunds after access is granted.
content_type: Daily signals, live market commentary, weekly reviews, member-only discussions.
who_is_it_for: People serious about trading — beginners who want to learn fast, and experienced traders who want a second perspective.
who_its_not_for: People looking for get-rich-quick tips or those who won't put in the work.

social_proof.typical_result: Most members say they recovered the subscription cost within the first week
social_proof.retention: Most members renew every month without being asked
social_proof.community_vibe: Very active group — people share their trades, ask questions, learn from each other

honest_limitations: We don't guarantee profits — no one can
You need to do your own analysis too — we give direction, not hand-holding
If you're looking for 100% win rate signals, this isn't the place

objection_responses.scam: Been running for 2 years. 200+ members. If it was a scam it wouldn't last this long.
objection_responses.expensive: ₹999 is less than one bad trade. Most members make it back in the first week.
objection_responses.worth_it: Depends on how serious you are. Serious traders find it worth it. Casual ones don't.
objection_responses.free_alternatives: There are free groups — but you get what you pay for. Signal quality is different.
objection_responses.proof: I can't show you P&L screenshots of others — privacy. But check how long we've been running.
objection_responses.think_about_it: Take your time. No rush. Most people who say that either join next week or regret not joining sooner.

faqs.question: Is this beginner friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes — many members started as beginners. The explanations are clear.

faqs.question: Which market?
faqs.answer: Primarily equity and options. Some crypto.

faqs.question: Can I try before paying?
faqs.answer: No free trial — but ₹999 is a low-risk way to check it out for a month.
